wigo.settings.title: What is going on (WIGO)
wigo.settings.share.description: Players within your sharing distance see your supported menus and chat draft. Turning this off removes your panel for them.
wigo.settings.receive.description: Shows supported menus of nearby players. Turning this off removes their panels and stops requesting them.
wigo.settings.viewing.locked: The server has disabled Smooth mode. Economical mode is active.
wigo.settings.viewing.description:
Economical
Menu data is sent while your character stands on an allowed side. Leaving that side stops transmission. Uses less traffic.

Smooth
Menu data keeps arriving on either side within the sharing distance. The menu is visible only when the camera is on an allowed side, including in F5. It fades in smoothly, but uses more traffic.
wigo.settings.unsupported.description: Shows the 'Menu not supported' panel with the screen name. Turn this off to hide these panels for yourself.
wigo.settings.range: Player menus within the permitted distance
wigo.settings.resources: Menus use your resources and texture packs.
wigo.settings.server.missing: WIGO on server: missing or incompatible
wigo.settings.tab.mine.description: Choose which menus you share, who sees them and from which side.
wigo.settings.tab.others.description: These settings change how other players’ panels look to you.
wigo.settings.mine.subtitle: Choose what other players can see.
wigo.settings.others.subtitle: Change how their menus look to you.
wigo.settings.menus.description: Choose which of your menus are shared. Server prohibitions always apply.
wigo.settings.menus.title: Which menus I share
wigo.settings.menus.help: On: share this menu. Off: keep it private. Server-blocked menus cannot be enabled.
wigo.settings.menu.description: Only affects sharing. You can still use this menu yourself.
wigo.settings.f8.description: Shares the open WIGO settings screen, including its tabs and player lists. Off by default.
wigo.settings.audience.description: Everyone: all nearby players. Whitelist: only listed players. Blacklist: everyone except listed players.
wigo.settings.side.description: Front and behind have matching boundaries relative to the panel, widened by one block to the left and right. Its direction is fixed when opened; an exactly edge-on view is hidden. Menu rules and player lists still apply.
wigo.settings.transparency.description: 0%: normal opacity. 50%: see the world through the menu. 100%: invisible. Only affects your view.
wigo.settings.brightness.description: 100%: normal brightness. Lower is dimmer; higher is brighter, up to 200%. 0%: black menu. Opacity stays the same. Only affects your view.
wigo.settings.size.description: 50%: half size. 100%: normal. 200%: double size. Independent of window resolution and GUI Scale.
wigo.settings.curvature.description: Negative values curve the edges away from the menu owner. 0%: flat panel. Positive values curve the edges around the owner, like a curved monitor. Further from zero means a stronger curve. Only affects your view.
wigo.settings.mirror.description: Face-to-face: you see the mirrored back of the menu. From the player’s side it reads normally. Off: readable on both sides.
wigo.settings.players.title: Who can see my menus
wigo.settings.players.name: Player name
wigo.settings.players.add.description: Add this player to the selected list. Online players are saved by UUID so their name can change. Up to 64 players per list.
wigo.settings.players.add.name: Add by name
wigo.settings.players.add.name.descripti: If a player is offline, enter their full name in the search box and press this button.
wigo.settings.players.remove: Remove this player from the list.
wigo.settings.players.help.all: All nearby players can see your enabled menus.
wigo.settings.players.help.whitelist: Only players in this list can see your menus.
wigo.settings.players.help.blacklist: Players in this list cannot see your menus.
wigo.settings.players.empty.whitelist: The whitelist is empty: nobody sees your menus.
wigo.settings.players.empty.blacklist: The blacklist is empty: everyone can see your menus.
wigo.settings.players.invalid: Enter a valid player name (letters, digits or underscore).
wigo.settings.players.duplicate: Already listed, or the list has reached 64 players.
wigo.menu.minecraft.inventory: Survival inventory, effects and recipe book
wigo.menu.minecraft.horse_inventory: Horse, donkey and other mount inventories
wigo.menu.minecraft.chat: Chat drafts and nearby draft preview
wigo.menu.wigo.other_vanilla: Other vanilla screens and confirmation dialogs
wigo.menu.wigo.unsupported: Name of an unsupported menu (no contents)
wigo.home.title: WIGO
wigo.home.enabled.description: Turns off WIGO menu sharing and viewing. Your personal settings are kept.
wigo.info.title: Info
wigo.settings.observers.description: Shows how many players receive your menu, subject to the server's counting rules. Smooth viewers also count while their panel is hidden.
wigo.settings.observers.locked: The server has disabled the observer counter.
wigo.settings.observers.place: Move the eye. Click to save its position.
wigo.settings.distance.description: Choose how close other players must be. Server maximum: %s blocks.
wigo.settings.distance.locked: The server locked the distance at %s blocks.
wigo.settings.autoBrightness.description: Adjusts menu brightness to nearby world light. Darker at night and underground, brighter in daylight or near lights. Only affects your view.
wigo.settings.panelOffset.description: Moves the menus you see up or down. The lower edge stops above the floor. Panels keep their size in tight spaces.
wigo.settings.panelPitch.description: Tilts the menus you see up or down by up to 60°. Zero keeps the panel upright.
wigo.settings.placement.reset.descriptio: Restores the original height and upright position of other players' menus.
wigo.settings.reset.title: Reset settings
wigo.settings.reset.description: Reset the settings on this tab.
wigo.settings.reset.confirm: Are you sure you want to reset the settings in “%s”?
wigo.settings.reset.sharing: Player lists and shared-menu choices will also return to defaults.

wigo.settings.shareChat.description: Share your chat draft. Turning this off also hides commands and nearby draft previews.
wigo.settings.shareCommands.description: Share drafts starting with /. Turn this off to keep commands private while sharing normal messages.
